name: seo-site-audit
summary: Orchestrate a bounded multi-domain site audit with summary-first SEO, web-quality, accessibility, and agent-readiness evidence.
inputs: site URL or local site artifact
external_reads: selected page responses and linked assets
approval_gates: external_read: approve live crawling and linked asset reads
vault_write: approve evidence writes when not already authorized
production and mutation: out of scope
done_when: site contract and caps are explicit
technical crawl, sitemap discovery, selected specialist checks, shallow web-quality/accessibility checks, and agent-readiness checks ran or blocked states are recorded
raw and normalized evidence is preserved
findings are labeled and pass seo-quality-gate or have a stated deferral
summary-first report contains domain statuses and deduplicated recommendations
verification: verify no unbounded crawl was run
verify tool limits and partial states are visible
verify sitemap discovery follows robots.txt before fallback testing
verify SEO, web-quality, accessibility, and agent-readiness checks are included, not applicable, or explicitly blocked
verify accessibility is not presented as legal or full WCAG compliance
verify no ranking, traffic, AI visibility, or agent-success guarantee is claimed
